restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรม กู๊ดเดย์ (Good Day Dental Clinic) สาขางามวงศ์วาน
text:
I saw a lot of good reviews and decided to try it, but the experience was the complete opposite.
First and last time. I wasn't impressed from the start.
- I went for teeth cleaning and asked about the price beforehand. I used my social security benefits. The price quoted via LINE was 700-1000 baht.
- However, before the procedure, they quoted a different price: 700-1200 baht. The price should have been clearer and not increased like that.
- My appointment was scheduled for 13:00, but I arrived at the clinic around 12:20. There were two other patients before me, which I accepted because I arrived early. Around 13:00, a counter staff member asked me to grab something to eat while I waited. They said it might be 30 minutes late because the doctor was also running late due to two other patients. They estimated the appointment would be around 13:30, but said they would call me. I said I would come back at 14:00. The staff member then said that at 14:00 there would be a booked appointment, which was essentially telling me to come in earlier. I didn't understand their intentions. But it was past our appointment time, so we had to go back at 2 PM.
-When we returned to the clinic around 1:50 PM, there was still one more person in the two appointments they had told us about who hadn't been served yet. We started to get annoyed. We sat and waited until a staff member came and told the elderly woman waiting that it would be her turn in 20 minutes. The elderly woman said that she had been waiting for 2 hours and 30 minutes and still hadn't been served. If we had to wait another 20 minutes, she should schedule an appointment for another day.
-It turned out that the 20-minute wait was for us. In the end, we were served at 2:20 PM, even though our appointment was at 1 PM.
And one more thing that I was extremely dissatisfied with:
** The counter staff gossiped about the elderly woman who had been waiting for 2 hours and 30 minutes for dental treatment. They said things like, "I've been waiting for dental treatment for about 2 hours and 30 minutes and still haven't been served. When will I get to eat?" etc., etc. Which was completely inappropriate. I was very unimpressed. I was initially planning to consult about orthodontics, but after this, I'm putting it off. ***
And I also told them that I was showing my displeasure with the service.
The staff member who spoke was middle-aged.
